summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Ramadan Iftar menu system. All 11 features passed testing. The app correctly displays Day 1 menu from ramadanMenus.json (Ezogelin Çorbası, Fırın Tavuk But, Pirinç Pilavı, Çoban Salata, Güllaç). Menu is deterministic across page refreshes. Dark mode is default. Ramadan progress bar shows Day 1 (3%). All 6 prayer times displayed. City selector functional with 18 Turkish cities.
passed_tests: ✅ Menu displays Day 1 data from JSON: Ezogelin Çorbası (soup), Fırın Tavuk But (main), Pirinç Pilavı (side), Çoban Salata (salad), Güllaç (dessert)
✅ Day badge shows '1. Gün' for first day of Ramadan
✅ Menu is DETERMINISTIC - same data on page refresh (verified with 2 loads)
✅ 5 menu categories displayed: Çorba, Ana Yemek, Pilav / Yan, Salata / Meze, Tatlı
✅ Ramadan progress bar showing Day 1 (3%): 'Ramazan'ın 1. günü — %3'
✅ Dark mode is default on initial load
✅ No ad containers or placeholders anywhere
✅ Prayer times grid displays all 6 times (İmsak, Güneş, Öğle, İkindi, Akşam, Yatsı)
✅ City selector works - 18 cities available, successfully changed from Erzincan to İstanbul
✅ Footer attribution present: 'This site was developed by Seyrani Kenger' and Diyanet attribution
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - MENU_DATA is properly embedded from JSON
Menu loading is deterministic using index-based access: MENU_DATA.ramadan_menus[dayOfRamadan - 1]
App.js is ~1118 lines - acceptable for current scope
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 requested features pass. App uses Diyanet API (emushaf.net) for prayer times. Today (Feb 19, 2026) is Day 1 of Ramadan 2026. Menu system uses embedded MENU_DATA from ramadanMenus.json - NO randomization, fully deterministic. Day 27 (March 17, 2026) will show Kadir Gecesi special with purple styling. Eid menus (Days 1-3: March 20-22) use eid_special_menus with amber/gold styling.
